P131-R19 fixed: new ww1/ww2/ww3 (sr2-block, _wave_writer_cases) - a wave of two writer members with their own trees: the committing member's decision is writer-committed naming the commit made in its tree with the project HEAD unmoved; the editing member is filed from its tree (gate green there, work carried in refs/audit/carry/P1.2, project file untouched); the locked digest is read from the member tree (lock_moved with tree [] vs without ['src/f2.txt']). Note: head_move's own tree argument is not separable in this fixture (worktrees share one object store); the tree reading pinned is tree_head's.
P131-R38 fixed: new dc4t pins that a terse green line with a record after the id ('...recorded <id>; pointer: ...') yields the id alone and that it names the held ledger row; existing dc4p did not separate the regex (it stayed green with \S+). held_gate_binds refusing a moved head or gate was already pinned by dc5, gr1, gr4.
P131-R41 fixed: reviewer_unread no longer dispatches; it spends the dispatched-reviewer mark and returns None, and advance only asks no-reviewer-return while that mark stands, so the redispatch is advance's own dispatch after stored_green/gate_step. reviewer_unread/reviewer_session_step lost their now-unused phase/tree parameters (only caller is in this file). Cases rv7 (task gate edited between the zero-tool session and the redispatch -> exactly one gate run, 'measured again', then the reviewer dispatch) and twin rv7b (unchanged gate -> no gate run).
P131-R42 fixed: rv8 (stream with no assistant event -> 'cannot count tool calls' stop, no cannot-tell note, no redispatch, nothing filed), rv9 (tools>0, prose result -> no-reviewer-return, nothing filed), rv10 (tools>0, object without verdict -> submit's shape refusal relayed, nothing filed).
P131-R43 no-change: HEAD's apply_answer 'redispatch' (drive-phase.py, `if answer == "redispatch":` block) already passes the member's tree from state.wave.trees, pinned by the existing sr2. Left on purpose: that human-answer path still dispatches directly rather than through advance's gate check (the class R41 closed for the automatic path), because returning None there changes how a wave member's step is re-entered, which sr2 pins.
P132-R1 no-change: HEAD's review_fix returns None once task.commit differs from the entry's 'from', and standing_review_fix tells a human re-open apart by the journal's newest task.reopen reason; pinned by existing rw7 (unit) and rw8 (closed at a new commit, re-opened by hand, next dispatch is the plain brief).

P135-R3 fixed: settle_aside's note/did-line now says what was done and what comes next ('...put back to HEAD; the drive proves and gates the declared work again, then asks the commit again') instead of 'is proved and gated again before it is committed'.
P137-R20 partly fixed, structural fix reported: the one-reader fix (start_row_of in _scoped_commit.py) needs a file outside this task's files and was not made. Added oc12, which pins the two readers' agreement: over rows of several attempts, another task's start and a non-start row, _attempt_start_moment and _scoped_commit.start_head_of pick the same row for each attempt (red when either predicate drifts).
